title: scanner-settings
description: The fingerprint scanner's hardware IDs for the fleet default, a client, a site or one cabinet; the most specific one set applies. null removes that level's setting. An ID may be a whole hardware ID (USB\\VID_1234&PID_5678) or a vendor prefix (USB\\VID_1234), which matches every model from that vendor. With none set anywhere, cabinets find the scanner themselves (the Biometric device class).

stepUpToken.description: Optional: a one-time step-up token bound to this exact action. These settings change no cabinet by themselves, so no code is required; a token, if sent, is consumed.
